        ### Question
        The effect of AMP-dependent protein kinase (AMPK) on lipid metabolism is:

        ### Options
        opa. Activate cholesterol synthesis, by phosphorylation of hydroxymethylglutaryl-CoA reductase (HMG-CoA network).
opb. Activate lipolysis in adipose tissue, through the phosphorylation of lipoprotein lipase (LPL).
opc. Inhibit beta-oxidation of fatty acids, by phosphorylation of acyl-CoA dehydrogenase.
opd. Inhibit lipogenesis by phosphorylation of acetyl-CoA carboxylase (ACC).

### Reasoning Chains per Option:
CHAIN: AMP-dependent protein kinase (AMPK) -> phosphorylation of acetyl-CoA carboxylase (ACC) -> inhibit lipogenesis -> 95% CHAIN: AMP-dependent protein kinase (AMPK) -> phosphorylation of lipoprotein lipase (LPL) -> activate lipolysis in adipose tissue -> 90% CHAIN: AMP-dependent protein kinase (AMPK) -> phosphorylation of acyl-CoA dehydrogenase -> inhibit beta-oxidation of fatty acids -> 95%

### Retrieved Evidence Paths (broad but correct):
(LIPOPROTEIN LIPASE)-INTERACTS_WITH->(Cells)-PART_OF->(Adipose tissue)
